model_output.verdict: Army logistics and maintenance leadership with clear results and a stated move into civilian operations.
write_up: Your resume makes a strong case for a supply chain or operations supervisor role! Your Army work connects team leadership, equipment accountability and maintenance improvements to concrete results.

The vehicle readiness line is the model: it gives the starting and ending rates and names the changes you made. Your experience leads, and your in-progress supply chain degree supports the direction you’ve named.

Your resume shouldn’t be the reason you don’t get a call back. Competition for a role and how an employer weighs military experience also matter. One useful final addition is what you taught the junior mechanics.

cards.line: - Cut the unit's vehicle non-mission-capable rate from 18% to 6% in a year by changing the parts ordering process and the weekly maintenance schedule
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model. You give a recruiter both the measure and the operational decisions behind it.
A recruiter can see how many mechanics you trained, but not what you taught them. That detail would show what the training covered.
